title: Lucas and the Park
text:
Lucas is fifteen years old. He lives in a small city with his parents and his sister. Every day after school, he goes to the park to play football with his friends. He likes the park because it is quiet and green.

On weekends, Lucas helps his grandmother in her garden. They grow tomatoes and flowers together. Lucas says that his grandmother teaches him many things. He is happy to spend time with her.

questions.text: What does Lucas do on weekends?
options: He plays football with his friends
He helps his grandmother in her garden
He visits his sister in another city

questions.text: What can we infer about Lucas's weekday afternoons?
options: He has time to relax and play after school
He has no friends at school
He works in a garden every day

questions.text: What can we infer about Lucas's relationship with his grandmother?
options: They are close and enjoy spending time together

vocabulary.definition: an area of land where plants and flowers grow
the mother of your mother or father

paragraph_translations: Lucas tem quinze anos. Ele mora em uma cidade pequena com seus pais e sua irmã. Todos os dias depois da escola, ele vai ao parque para jogar futebol com os amigos. Ele gosta do parque porque é tranquilo e verde.
Nos fins de semana, Lucas ajuda sua avó no jardim dela. Eles cultivam tomates e flores juntos. Lucas diz que sua avó lhe ensina muitas coisas. Ele fica feliz em passar tempo com ela.
